runs.description: Invocations the plugin infers, each a program and its arguments

applications.description: Bundle names of the applications the invocations archive, each invocation taking -archivePath <n>.xcarchive in a temporary folder, once every invocation succeeds each bundle under an archive's Products taking its path below / in one renamex_np, swapped with the bundle installed there, so a failed invocation leaves the installed bundle untouched, then each one holding Contents/Library/LaunchAgents launched once more with open -n -g -j -W, behind the user's windows, so its SMAppService registration replaces the agents still running the build it swapped out, and a running executable inside one named in the last line as needing a relaunch

results.description: Result bundle paths, the one at an invocation's index passed to it as -resultBundlePath, each removed before the first invocation runs, as xcodebuild refuses a result bundle path that exists

dryRun.description: Prints each invocation and runs none

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

outputs.description: Files the configuration writes, which the target's outputs name through {options.outputs.<n>}

title: Run
description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed and git status.branch off after the caller's GIT_CONFIG_<n> entries, stopping at the first failure
